prompt: Imagine an agent computes an intermediate value correctly but types it into the cell as a plain number instead of a formula. The final output therefore shows the right figure. Which check will catch this?
options: Neither, because the delivered numbers all match the reference within tolerance
Perturbation, because the output will not move when an upstream input is changed
Output Validation, because the judge sees that the output is not formula-driven

private.resolution: Output Validation only compares the current value with the reference, so a correct typed-in number passes it. Perturbation changes an input and recalculates, and the hardcoded cell then stops the change from reaching the output. Try it in the widget below.
